notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
1 new winter map
2 new winter hats
Bugfix: skins and hats of teammates were not synced correctly online
Bugfix: starting lines were not synchronized correctly online
Bugfix: When playing with real beer, only the host could correctly mark his beer as finished

notes.title: Update 1.0.22
notes.notes:
Bug fix: Inspection of skill upgrades can be cancelled correctly
 Better UI symbols
 The game is instantly finished when all players of a team have finished their beer. Even in real beer mode
 New calculation approach for the xp needed to level up
